svg.title: The Firebreak corpus to scale
svg.desc: 1,170 curated records drawn as dots. 637 experiment rows include 148 solid-material rows, 13 documented outcomes and 6 pressure-bearing microgravity anchors. 533 characterisation rows are labelled and never graded.
svg.text: 1,170 records. Six anchor every grade A.
Everything else is a label, a gap, or
